detail.longDescription:
From a question on Lobste.rs I’m now wondering.

Lua famously only requires a C89 compiler. However I’m pretty sure it assumes things that aren’t mandated by C89 (CHAR_BITS==8, two’s complement, and non-trapping overflows all spring to mind, IEEE 754 NaN’s maybe). I’m not sure if any of these are required but those would be my bets.

Anyway, I’d be willing to bet epsilon dollars that the systems that don’t have a C99 compiler are those that don’t meet the other expectations. 

#lua #programming
